name: e-News-Lucky
summary: This EA is designed to trade around scheduled news events by placing pending orders on both sides of the current price before a news release, capturing breakout moves triggered by volatility spikes. It uses a time-based filter to open straddle orders shortly before the news event and manages them with stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy relies on the volatility expansion that typically accompanies high-impact economic news announcements.
summary_zh: 该EA专为新闻事件交易设计，在重大经济数据发布前在当前价格两侧放置挂单，捕捉新闻引发的价格突破走势。它利用时间过滤器在新闻发布前短暂时间内开立跨式订单，并通过止损和止盈进行风险管理。策略依赖于高影响力新闻公告通常带来的波动率扩张。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于新闻事件驱动的波动性突破，在预定的新闻发布时间前同时放置买入止损和卖出止损挂单，形成跨式布局。入场条件为：当前时间接近设定的新闻发布时间（在指定的时间窗口内），且在该窗口内自动在当前价格上方放置BuyStop订单、下方放置SellStop订单。出场条件包括：订单被触发后按设定的止盈平仓，或按止损平仓，或新闻事件过后一定时间内未触发的挂单被自动删除。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于可用保证金的比例来计算每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大持仓数量限制以及每日最大亏损限制，以防止连续新闻事件导致过度亏损。整体策略的核心假设是重大新闻发布会引发足够大的价格波动，使跨式订单中的一侧被触发并获得盈利覆盖另一侧的亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on news-event-driven volatility breakout, placing both a buy stop and a sell stop pending order simultaneously before a scheduled news release, forming a straddle layout. Entry conditions: when the current time approaches the configured news release time within a specified time window, the EA automatically places a BuyStop order above the current price and a SellStop order below it. Exit conditions include: triggered orders are closed at the configured take-profit or stop-loss levels, and untriggered pending orders are automatically deleted after a specified period following the news event. Position sizing is handled either through fixed lot sizes or through a percentage-based calculation relative to available margin. Money management features include maximum open position limits and daily maximum loss limits to prevent excessive losses from consecutive news events. The core assumption of the strategy is that major news releases cause sufficient price movement for one side of the straddle to be triggered and profit enough to cover the loss on the other side.

parameters.name: MinutesBefore
parameters.description: 新闻发布前多少分钟开始放置挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes before news to place pending orders

parameters.name: MinutesAfter
parameters.description: 新闻发布后多少分钟删除未触发挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes after news to delete untriggered pending orders

parameters.name: DistancePips
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: MaxDailyLoss
parameters.description: 每日最大亏损金额限制

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its orders

pros: 利用新闻事件的高波动性捕捉大行情，盈利潜力可观
跨式挂单策略无需判断方向，只要波动足够大即可获利
设有每日最大亏损限制，具有一定的资金保护机制
未触发挂单自动删除，避免新闻行情过后不必要的持仓风险
pros_en: Capitalizes on high volatility around news events for significant profit potential
Straddle order strategy eliminates the need to predict direction — profits if volatility is sufficient
Daily maximum loss limit provides a degree of capital protection
Automatic deletion of untriggered pending orders avoids unnecessary position risk after the news event passes
cons: 滑点和点差扩大在新闻发布时极为常见，可能导致止损被放大或入场价格远超预期
跨式策略在低波动新闻事件中两侧订单可能均被触发导致双重亏损
依赖精确的时间设定，若新闻时间延迟或提前，策略可能失效
缺乏对新闻重要性的动态筛选，所有新闻事件统一处理可能产生虚假信号
cons_en: Slippage and spread widening are extremely common during news releases, potentially causing enlarged stop-losses or entry prices far worse than expected
In low-volatility news events, both sides of the straddle may be triggered, resulting in a double loss
Relies on precise time configuration — if the news release is delayed or early, the strategy may fail
Lacks dynamic filtering of news importance, treating all news events uniformly may generate false signals
improvements: 集成经济日历API自动获取新闻发布时间和影响力等级，替代手动设定时间
增加波动率过滤机制，如基于ATR动态调整挂单距离和止损止盈比例
添加点差过滤器，在新闻发布前点差过大时暂停放置挂单
improvements_en: Integrate an economic calendar API to automatically fetch news release times and impact levels, replacing manual time configuration
Add a volatility filter mechanism such as ATR-based dynamic adjustment of pending order distance and stop-loss/take-profit ratios
Add a spread filter that suspends order placement when spreads widen excessively before news releases

risk_points: 新闻发布时点差和滑点急剧扩大，止损可能无法按预期价格执行
跨式订单在剧烈波动中可能两侧均被触发（whipsaw），造成双倍亏损
缺乏对新闻事件影响力的动态评估，可能在不重要的新闻事件上冒险交易
risk_points_en: Spreads and slippage expand dramatically during news releases, and stop-losses may not execute at expected prices
Both sides of the straddle may be triggered during violent whipsaw movements, causing double losses
Lacks dynamic assessment of news event impact, potentially risking trades on insignificant news events

It uses a time-based filter to open straddle orders shortly before the news event and manages them with stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy relies on the volatility expansion that typically accompanies high-impact economic news announcements.
